scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared apps/api && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fpc/web && npm run build -w @fpc/api
scripts.dev: echo "Run in two terminals: npm run dev -w @fpc/api  and  npm run dev -w @fpc/web"
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run e2e
